desc: Replace aggregate residue-count invariants with order-preserving residue-sequence comparisons.
Verify the corrected implementation on the two public samples.
Exhaustively compare connected components for small \(N\) against the ordered residue-sequence invariants.
Prove that each operation preserves the ordered residue sequences and that these invariants are sufficient for non-isolated states.
Verify degenerate cases, including \(X=Y\), \(X=1\), \(Y=1\), and \(X+Y>N\), through exhaustive testing and proof.
